question.text: A trader buys a USDINR call option with strike 84.00 at a premium of Rs. 0.25. At expiry, USDINR is at 84.60. What is the net profit per unit?

explanation.text: The Logic: A long-call exercise payoff is spot minus strike when spot is above strike. Here payoff = 84.60 - 84.00 = Rs. 0.60. Net profit per unit deducts the premium paid: 0.60 - 0.25 = Rs. 0.35. The currency option lot size is 1000 USD. The Trap: Rs. 0.60 is the gross intrinsic payoff before subtracting the premium; the premium paid by the buyer must always be deducted when computing net profit. Note: Workbook reference — pp.80-82 (long-call payoff and net profit framework, currency option lot size of 1000 USD).
